name: piston-push-limit
comment: Push limit (BlockPistonBase.canExtend / tryExtend: at most 12 blocks). Piston A at (-7,61,-3) faces +x (meta 5) into 12 stones (x -6..5), piston B at (-7,61,3) into 13 stones (x -6..6); torches (76, meta 5) behind both at t=1. A extends (stones to x -5..6), B does not (no meta change, no sound draw). At t=5 B's 13th stone is removed (not a neighbour of B: nothing happens), at t=6 a stone placed beside B at (-7,61,4) makes it re-check and extend. Needs BlockRedstoneTorch (redstone task of WP-1.6) for the power.
